title: MindKraft: from job-search chaos to a clearer next step

steps.narration: The job search can become a full-time job of its own. MindKraft starts by putting the important pieces in one place.
steps.caption: From scattered tasks to one clearer workspace.

steps.narration: First, you explain what you are looking for. Then the search can focus on roles that make sense for your experience and plans.
steps.caption: Start with roles worth your time.
steps.assertText: Tell us what you’re looking for

steps.narration: Finding a role is only the beginning. MindKraft helps you strengthen the CV and answers for the application in front of you.
steps.caption: Make each application more relevant.

steps.narration: The useful distinction is control: you review the details, approve the final version, and decide when an application is ready.
steps.caption: Support helps. You decide.

steps.narration: After you apply, the tracker keeps the role, status, updates, and next action together instead of hiding them across tabs and inboxes.
steps.caption: Know what happened and what comes next.
steps.assertText: Every submitted application in one place

steps.narration: When you need a nudge, community tips add practical lessons from people who are going through the same process.
steps.caption: Useful advice, right where the search happens.

steps.narration: That is the MindKraft promise: less searching in circles, more focused progress, with one clear next step each morning.
steps.caption: Wake up to progress, not procrastination.
